protocol.name: Complete-window CARA evaluation
protocol.forecast: Trailing 24-hour mean, repeated over the 24-hour target; identical for all methods in a case.
protocol.incumbent: Common FFD placement constructed from the current forecast for each case.

longitudinal.partial_final_days: Excluded; every evaluated target has 24 observed hours for every cohort VM.

evaluation_union.reuse: A cohort/origin/stream is executed once per method and reused in every applicable analysis view.

protocol.hourly_scope: Complete-series query execution in original CPU units. No source provides 192 history hours plus a 24-hour target for every series, so these objects are not enlarged placement-quality cohorts under the same protocol.
protocol.development_rule: Method and parameter choices use only the development cases. Freeze the method before the evaluation union is run; retain all evaluation cases and methods.
protocol.temporal_interpretation: Primary targets overlap. Longitudinal targets do not overlap within a cohort, but this is a sequence of paired decision contexts with a current common incumbent, not a stateful deployment rollout. Random streams repeat search, not observed workloads.

prediction_intervals.scale: Per-VM preceding-24-hour sample standard deviation, ddof=1; no target fitting.

protocol.budget_scope: Per-method historical representation construction, RNG and controller setup, and proposal processing consume the same process-CPU allowance. Selection and historical admission are reported separately and in the complete decision cost. Atomic operations already begun may finish after the allowance, with observed overshoot retained.
protocol.solver_scope: Scenario-MIP runs separately with one worker. Model construction is charged before the remaining allowance is passed to HiGHS as a wall-time limit; actual construction, solver CPU, solver wall time, and overshoot are reported.
protocol.evaluation_access: Target slices and outcomes are computed only after all methods in the case have frozen their actions and historical admission decisions. Search inputs contain only the declared history. Shared interval diagnostics are then computed for every terminal placement, including incumbent fallbacks.

rotation: Each case rotates the declared method order by its index; the separate solver study is not in that joint rotation.
timing: Actual process CPU. Preparation and proposal share the allowance; Selection, physical-action validation and Audit are included in complete decision cost. Common data loading, forecast/FFD construction, outcome evaluation and serialization are excluded. Solver CPU and wall observations retain their separate meaning.
